title: 2026 FAQs – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: The 48th Bank of America Chicago Marathon takes place on Sunday 11 October 2026.
The Chicago Marathon takes place on the second Sunday of October, and future dates are subject to change.
The 2026 entry fee is $250 for US residents and $260 for non-US residents, plus a processing fee.
Charity-programme participants must raise no less than $2,200.

Time-qualifier results must come from a marathon run on a course certified by USA Track & Field, World Athletics or a similar governing association, within the qualifying window of 1 January 2024 to 18 November 2025.
The FAQ states that future race dates are subject to change.
